rollbacks.reason: Pre-release rollback readiness for high-risk Kairo V1 pilot release REL-001. Use if deployment, health/version checks, authentication, tenant isolation, publishing safeguards, or post-deploy smoke verification fail.
triggers: API live/readiness or /version exact-SHA check fails
Authentication/session bootstrap fails for pilot users
Workspace or Brand tenant-isolation check fails
Publishing bypasses capability or human-approval safeguards
Database migration or application startup failure threatens data integrity
procedure: Stop or route away pilot traffic for the affected component.
Disable external publishing automation and retain manual fallback.
Preserve logs, audit records and failure evidence; do not delete pilot data during triage.
If schema state is implicated, prefer forward recovery; restore the approved Neon backup only when forward recovery is unsafe.
Redeploy the last known-good certified pilot runtime cb273c59e83c3043313127f15afc717b33577958 for affected runtime components, or keep the component disabled when no prior deployed version exists.
Verify /health/live, /health/ready and /version provenance, then verify authentication and tenant isolation before reopening traffic.
verification: Version endpoint reports the intended rollback SHA
External publishing remains disabled or capability-gated as intended

rollbacks.reason: Rollback readiness for the high-risk VS-82 Instagram completion release.
triggers: API health or exact release provenance fails
Instagram publisher startup or reconciliation regresses
Tenant isolation, destination approval or media fingerprint binding fails
Calendar or Results loses provider-confirmed publish lineage
procedure: Disable KAIRO_INSTAGRAM_PUBLISHER_ENABLED while preserving commands, attempts, provider IDs and metrics.
Redeploy the final certified runtime or last-known-good SHA according to the failure boundary.
Do not roll back migrations 0023 through 0028; use forward recovery for schema defects.
Verify health, version, authentication, Brand scope and publishing safeguards before re-enabling the worker.
verification: API health and version provenance are green
Publishing remains destination-bound and exact-version approved
Calendar and Results preserve existing provider evidence

rollbacks.reason: Rollback readiness for the high-risk VS-83 adaptive carousel renderer production release while provider-backed carousel validation is still observing.
triggers: API startup, readiness or exact release provenance regresses
The recovered carousel project still fails render before quality evaluation
Rendered media hashes, dimensions, tenant lineage or approved-version binding regress
Instagram carousel publishing bypasses approval or fails provider delivery after an approved retry
Calendar or Results loses provider-confirmed carousel lineage
procedure: Disable KAIRO_INSTAGRAM_PUBLISHER_ENABLED if the failure affects publishing while preserving commands, attempts, provider IDs and audit state.
Redeploy last-known-good API SHA 57447bb607a4bc278cde992a95727376dde7a4ce if the adaptive renderer release itself is implicated.
Do not roll back VS-83 storage migrations; this renderer fix introduces no new migration and schema recovery should remain forward-only.
Preserve the exact Brand, Campaign, Asset and Carousel Project lineage plus Render logs before recovery.
Verify API startup, authentication, tenant isolation, private-object delivery and publishing safeguards before re-enabling the affected flow.
verification: API health and exact release provenance are green
Authentication and Brand tenant isolation pass
Carousel rendering either succeeds or fails only through the configured quality policy rather than text-layout overflow
Approved media remains immutable, private and destination-bound
Calendar and Results preserve existing provider evidence
